description: Get one institution's structure-change history by CERT, newest first: the mergers it absorbed or was absorbed in, failures and assisted takeovers, branch purchases and sales, renames, relocations, charter and regulator changes, openings, and closings, each with its effective date, FDIC change code, the institution's role, and the other institution's CERT and name. A merger or failure appears once, from whichever side the CERT was on. Branch-level openings, closings, sales, and relocations are left out unless event_types includes branch. Merger records start in 1969 and failure records in 1970.

event_types.description: Nonempty selection of at most 1000 event types, deduplicated: merger, failure_or_assistance, branch_purchase, name_change, relocation, charter_change, opening, closing, other (a change code this server has not classified), branch (branch-level openings, closings, sales, and relocations). Omit for every type but branch; echoed as event_types_filter.

from_date.description: Earliest effective date to include (YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2008-01-01).

limit.description: Events per page, at least 1. The whole matching history is read, so any limit is served; use next_offset to continue.

offset.description: Events to skip; pass next_offset from the previous page.

name: fdic_get_institution_history

cap.description: The limit applied to this page.

data_as_of.description: When FDIC last rebuilt the history index (ISO timestamp).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `cert_not_found`: No institution record carries this CERT. `invalid_date`: from_date or to_date names a day its month does not have. `invalid_date_range`: from_date is after to_date. `pacer_shed`: This server's shared FDIC request queue is saturated and the call would wait past its budget. `upstream_rate_limited`: FDIC answered 429 and retries were exhausted. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

event_types_filter.description: The event types searched, after the default and deduplication.

events.description: Events on this page, newest first.

branch.description: The office a branch event concerns, as it stood after the change.

change_description.description: FDIC's label for the change code, verbatim.

changes.description: Attributes whose former and new values FDIC both recorded and that differ: name, address, city, state, bank_class, chartering_agency, regulator. Subject and branch events only; absent when none changed.

from.description: Value FDIC recorded before the change.

to.description: Value FDIC recorded after the change.

bank_class.description: Charter class code, e.g. NM; FDIC also records CU and NS here.

from.description: Value FDIC recorded before the change.

to.description: Value FDIC recorded after the change.

chartering_agency.description: Chartering agency, e.g. STATE or OCC.

from.description: Value FDIC recorded before the change.

to.description: Value FDIC recorded after the change.

from.description: Value FDIC recorded before the change.

to.description: Value FDIC recorded after the change.

name.description: Legal name, or office name on a branch event.

from.description: Value FDIC recorded before the change.

to.description: Value FDIC recorded after the change.

regulator.description: Primary federal regulator, e.g. FDIC or FED.

from.description: Value FDIC recorded before the change.

to.description: Value FDIC recorded after the change.

from.description: Value FDIC recorded before the change.

to.description: Value FDIC recorded after the change.

counterparty.description: The other institution: the survivor for outgoing, the absorbed bank for survivor, the seller for buyer, the buyer for seller, the former certificate for a code 150 CERT change. Absent when FDIC recorded none.

cert.description: CERT of the other institution, when recorded.

name.description: Name of the other institution, as recorded.

event_type.description: This server's class of the change code; fdic_list_reference topic change_codes maps each code.

role.description: The institution's part: subject (a change to itself), outgoing (it ceased in this merger or failure), survivor (it absorbed the counterparty), buyer or seller (of branches).

transaction_number.description: FDIC transaction number (TRANSNUM); rows of one transaction share it.

institution.description: The institution record for the CERT.

active.description: True while the charter is open and insured.

ended_on.description: Date the charter ended (YYYY-MM-DD); inactive institutions only.

name.description: Current legal name, or the name at closing.

successor_cert.description: CERT of the institution that continued the franchise.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page; present when more events remain.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched, the page is past the end, or more pages remain.

total.description: Events matching the filters across all pages.

truncated.description: True when more events remain beyond this page.

title: Get institution structure-change history
